description: Defines the MediaFoundationStreamWrapper class implementing IMFMediaStream for Windows media rendering, including methods for stream control, event queuing, and buffer processing.

classes.name: MediaFoundationStreamWrapper
classes.description: Implements IMFMediaStream for Windows media rendering, managing stream state, buffers, and events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new MediaFoundationStreamWrapper instance.

methods.name: RuntimeClassInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the stream with provided parameters.

methods.name: SetTaskRunner
methods.description: Sets the task runner for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: HasEnded
methods.description: Checks if the stream has ended.

methods.name: SetSelected
methods.description: Marks the stream as selected in the pipeline.

methods.name: IsSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the stream is selected.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the stream is enabled.

methods.name: IsEncrypted
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is encrypted (virtual, to be implemented by derived classes).

methods.name: TransformSample
methods.description: Allows derived classes to modify samples before sending.

methods.name: AreFormatChangesEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if format changes are enabled.

methods.name: StreamType
methods.description: Returns the type of the demuxer stream.

methods.name: OnDemuxerStreamRead
methods.description: Handles completion of demuxer stream read.

methods.name: OnDemuxerStreamReadBuffers
methods.description: Handles batch buffers received from demuxer.

methods.name: RequestSample
methods.description: Requests a sample from the stream.

methods.name: GetLastKeyId
methods.description: Returns the last key ID used for encryption.
